Package hadur.bench

Class RobotJar

java.lang.Object
hadur.bench.RobotJar
final class RobotJar extends Object
Where the built robot lives and which release it is, so that no bench default lags the project version (issue #102). The release comes from hadur-robot/pom.xml's robot.release property, which is what names the jars; when the pom cannot be read (the bench run from somewhere else), the newest built jar's name stands in.
